svg.text: The Colour Was There All Along
an autumn plate — unveiling, invention, and the quiet cut · drawn procedurally, seed 20261020
A · Gold is not made in autumn. It is unmasked —
the green was simply louder, all summer.
B · Red is the opposite trick: a pigment invented
for a leaf the tree is about to drop.
suberin + lignin seal the twig side
are carried home to twig and root
then a breath of wind is enough
C · Abscission, from Latin abscindere, to cut away:
a pre-built tear line, sealed before it tears.
each patch = one clone, one root system,
turning all at once, on its own schedule
D · A quaking aspen grove is usually a single
organism — autumn reveals its true borders.
E · The Recipe for a Brilliant Year
a healthy leaf to begin with
and the master switch over all of it:
E · Weather tunes the intensity; lengthening
nights, reliable as astronomy, set the date.
F · Marcescence: the abscission layer never quite
finishes — so winter keeps a rustling brown crown.
Plate XVI · The Colour Was There All Along — Lapis, atelier, October 20, 2026
